Subtract 24 weeks = 168 days.  
Add 6 days → total subtract 174 days.  
1501 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 400, so not leap).  
From 11-19-1501 back 174 days:  
October: back 19 days to Nov 1 → Oct 13 (19 days back).  
Remaining 155 days: back through months.  

Count back:  
Oct: 13 days (from Oct 13 to Oct 1) → 12 days before Oct 1 is Sep 19.  
Actually easier: 174 days before Nov 19, 1501.  

Days in months before Nov 19:  
Oct: 31 days → back to Oct 19 is 31 days before Nov 19.  
Sep: 30 days → back to Sep 19 is 61 days before Nov 19.  
Aug: 31 days → back to Aug 19 is 92 days before Nov 19.  
Jul: 31 days → back to Jul 19 is 123 days before Nov 19.  
Jun: 30 days → back to Jun 19 is 153 days before Nov 19.  
Need 174 days before Nov 19: 153 days before is Jun 19. Need 21 more days back.  
Back into May: May has 31 days. Jun 19 back 21 days → May 29 (since May 31 → Jun 1, so May 29 is 21 days before Jun 19).  

Check: From May 29 to Nov 19:  
May: 3 days (29,30,31)  
Jun: 30  
Jul: 31  
Aug: 31  
Sep: 30  
Oct: 31  
Nov: 19  
Sum = 3+30=33, +31=64, +31=95, +30=125, +31=156, +19=175 days difference. Wait, that’s 175 days, not 174.  

Recalc: May 29 to May 31 = 2 days in May.  
June: 30 days → 32 total  
July: 31 → 63  
Aug: 31 → 94  
Sep: 30 → 124  
Oct: 31 → 155  
Nov 1 to Nov 19 = 19 days → total 174 days. Yes, correct.
